_doc: 版本標識檔。guardian＝Workflow Guardian（hooks + MCP server）版本，Dashboard 標題與 MCP serverInfo 顯示；atom_memory＝原子記憶系統版本；release_date＝此版本正式發布日；release_theme＝此版本主題一句話。程式讀者：tools/workflow-guardian-mcp/lib/paths.js（只取 guardian / atom_memory）與 tools/install.py --verify（確認本檔可讀）；文件讀者 TECH.md。
release_theme: Root-leak gate degrades to warn, with a once-per-session hint to rerun install.py --upgrade, when this machine's settings do not hook root_write_declare in PostToolUse; the ledger records the effective mode and root-leak-audit counts degraded records; the dispatcher exits early for PostToolUse events of this system's MCP tools it does not book; org-layer background sync also carries tools/ by default; the cross-realm Bash guard recognizes /home, /Users and /root home paths; atom-move uses shutil.move so cards move across drives; eight case files set up their own isolated environment and the scaffold command form has a case for both code-root layouts
